state.project: Miu World: a voxel learning game for Vietnamese grade-2 children (web, iPad), built 100% by AI. The owner's single wish: the game must be lively so children never get bored. Currently only the owner and one child play it; no outside players.
decisions_already_made_by_owner: Abuse reporting and moderation are skipped while only the owner and the child play.
Plans approved: system screens, boss and skill check, parent area, English subject, co-op, live events, launch readiness.
facts: The real TIMO (Thailand International Mathematical Olympiad) preliminary round for grade 2 is on 2026-10-10: 25 multiple-choice questions, 4 points each, 60 minutes, no penalty for wrong answers, no calculator, single submission, done on Google Forms. The owner's child is taking it. TIMO is another organisation's name and exam; its practice book is copyrighted and forbids copying, and the game repository is public (MIT).

Today is 2026-10-04, six days before the exam. A one-player practice mode (one gate in the forest, original grade-2 puzzles on the five TIMO topics, a mock test with the same rules and an optional 60-minute clock, medals at 20/40/60/80 points) is a medium-size slice that does not depend on any other plan.

English is a subject in the game but has only 1 skill and 0 quests. Grade-2 English content would be written for the 12 maps. The school uses a published English textbook with copyright; the repo is public.
A streak (consecutive play days) was mentioned in the first Master Plan table but never decided. Children are young; streak pressure is a known risk.
All rewards, XP and coins are computed on the server today (rule of the project, already implemented).
Limited-time event items can be re-opened later as a commemorative version.
The game reads text aloud with the browser's built-in voices (vi-VN, en-US) today.
A boss quiz at the end of each map is planned (500 HP, each correct answer removes HP).

timo_practice_before_exam.instructions: Should the AI build the one-player TIMO practice mode now so the child can practise before the real exam on 2026-10-10, ahead of the other approved plans?

criteria.build_now: Build the small practice slice now and put it ahead of the other approved plans; close the gate on 2026-10-10.
criteria.defer: Keep the approved order; treat the 2026 exam as already passed and build the event later.

timo_name.instructions: What name should the public game use for the math olympiad practice event, given that TIMO is another organisation's name and the repository is public?

criteria.generic_name: Use a generic name such as 'Thử thách Olympic Toán' and say only that problems follow the Olympic style for grade 2; do not use the TIMO label anywhere in the game or repository text meant for players.
criteria.timo_name: Use the name 'TIMO Challenge' as in the owner's mock, accepting the risk of looking officially affiliated.

english_source.instructions: Where should the grade-2 English quests take their content from?

criteria.self_written_by_framework: Write original content following the Ministry of Education grade-2 framework and compare topics with the school's textbook so the child's lessons match, without copying the textbook text; a teacher reviews a sample.
criteria.follow_textbook_text: Use the school's textbook wording directly in the game, as is done for the Vietnamese textbooks.

streak.instructions: Should the game have a consecutive-days-played streak?

criteria.gentle_streak: Add a gentle streak: one free rest day per week, no penalty for breaking it, small rewards, no reminder screens.
criteria.no_streak: Do not add any streak; keep the game free of daily-play pressure.

commemorative_items.instructions: After a limited-time event ends, should its exclusive items be available again as a commemorative version?

criteria.reopen_commemorative: Yes, re-open them later as commemorative versions so a child who joined late is not sad.
criteria.gone_forever: No, limited items are gone after the event.

voice_recording.instructions: For English listening and speaking, should the game use recorded human voices or the browser's built-in voices?

criteria.browser_voices: Keep the browser's built-in voices for now; no recording work and no cost.
criteria.recorded_voices: Record human voices for English words and sentences.

boss_timer.instructions: Should the end-of-map boss quiz have a time limit per question?

criteria.no_time_limit: No time limit; children read carefully; only gentle rhythm effects.

auto_bot_partner.instructions: In co-op challenges, when only one child is present, should a companion bot be paired automatically?

criteria.only_if_parent_enabled: Pair a bot only if the parent has turned companion bots on.

reward_cheats.instructions: The owner said cheating is welcome. Should rewards, XP and coins stay computed on the server only, or should the game add fun cheat codes (for example a secret code that gives coins) kept separate from learning data?

criteria.keep_server_authority: Keep all rewards, XP and coins computed on the server only; no cheat codes. Learning data stays trustworthy and nothing extra is built.
criteria.separate_fun_cheats: Add secret fun cheat codes behind a separate flag that never touches learning progress or skill levels (coins and cosmetics only).
